verdict.rationale: Instinct's Terms document a training opt-out at app.instinct.com/settings, and Materials stored in the Vault are never used to train AI models. Community screenshots of the original ToS show a broad perpetual license that included model training. That reflects the default posture rather than proving the opt-out fails, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: the opt-out is on-by-default training requiring user action, its scope and retroactivity are undocumented beyond a single sentence, and there is no hands-on or independent confirmation that it works.
